content:
Phong is back at work today. His friend Khoa asks him about his trip to Hanoi yesterday.

Khoa asks, "How was your flight?"
Phong says, "Terrible! It was three hours late. My flight was delayed because of bad weather in Hanoi."
"Oh no! What were you doing all that time?"
"First, I was sitting at the gate and reading a magazine. Then I was hungry, so I bought a sandwich and a coffee."
"Were there a lot of people?"
"Yes, hundreds of passengers were waiting. Some children were running around, and an old man was sleeping on three seats."
Khoa laughs. "Did you sleep too?"
"No, I didn't. While I was eating my sandwich, I met an old friend from school. She was waiting for the same flight."
"Really? That's lucky."
"Yes. We were talking about our school days when they called our flight. The three hours went very fast!"

grammarNote.title: Quá khứ tiếp diễn (when, while)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Quá khứ tiếp diễn kể cảnh đang diễn ra lúc chờ đợi: I was sitting at the gate, hundreds of passengers were waiting, an old man was sleeping. While + quá khứ tiếp diễn, rồi một việc ngắn xen vào ở quá khứ đơn: While I was eating my sandwich, I met an old friend. Hoặc ngược lại với when: We were talking … when they called our flight.
examples: "First, I was sitting at the gate and reading a magazine.
While I was eating my sandwich, I met an old friend from school.
We were talking about our school days when they called our flight.

annotate.writingPrompt: Write about a time you were waiting for a long time (at an airport, a station or a hospital): what were you and other people doing?
sentenceTranslations: Hôm nay Phong đi làm lại.
Bạn anh là Khoa hỏi về chuyến đi Hà Nội hôm qua.
Khoa hỏi: "Chuyến bay thế nào?"
Phong nói: "Tệ lắm!
Trễ ba tiếng.
Chuyến bay bị hoãn vì thời tiết xấu ở Hà Nội."
"Ôi!
Thế suốt thời gian đó cậu làm gì?"
"Đầu tiên, mình ngồi ở cửa ra máy bay đọc tạp chí.
Sau đó mình đói, nên mua một cái bánh mì kẹp và một cốc cà phê."
"Có đông người không?"
"Có, hàng trăm hành khách đang chờ.
Mấy đứa trẻ chạy lung tung, còn một ông cụ thì nằm ngủ trên ba cái ghế."
Khoa cười.
"Thế cậu có ngủ không?"
"Không.
Đang ăn bánh mì thì mình gặp một người bạn cũ hồi đi học.
Cô ấy cũng đang chờ chuyến bay đó."
"Thật à?
May thế."
Bọn mình đang nói chuyện hồi đi học thì loa gọi lên máy bay.
Ba tiếng trôi qua nhanh lắm!"

practice.objectiveVi: Bạn có thể kể mình và mọi người đang làm gì trong lúc chờ đợi bằng was / were + V-ing, while và when.

practice.grammarTipVi: Hỏi lúc đó ở đâu, làm gì: Where were you? What were you doing? Trả lời: I was waiting at the airport. Phủ định quá khứ đơn: I didn't hear it.

options: Quá khứ tiếp diễn (I was eating)
grammarStep.explanationVi: While đi với việc đang diễn ra, kéo dài: While I was eating …; việc ngắn xen vào dùng quá khứ đơn: I met.
grammarStep.whenVi: While + việc dài (was / were + V-ing); when + việc ngắn xen vào (quá khứ đơn).

writingHelp.modelAnswer: Last month, I was waiting for my train at Hue station. The train was two hours late. I was sitting on a seat and reading a book. Some people were eating, and two children were playing a game. While I was drinking a coffee, a woman asked me for help with her bags. We were talking when the train came.
